title: THE EXTRACTION CARD SHOWS THE HAUL
why: Seen on the extraction card screenshot of 2026-10-07: the card told you how many items you secured and what they were worth, but never showed them. A strip of their pictures now sits under that line, most valuable first, each framed in its rarity colour, up to twelve and then a count.
now: The EXTRACTED card shows pictures of what you brought home.
